# solo-msa_v2-gemini-3-flash-flash_10-high

## Experiment

One agent implements both features with `gemini-3-flash-preview` at `high` thinking, the level our `gemini-3.8-flash` runs use. Budgets are the upstream defaults (100 steps, compaction at 28K). Together with the same model at `minimal` and `low`, it shows what the thinking level changes for this model, and it compares the two models at `high`.

## Observations

- 5/10, compared with 7/10 at `minimal` and 5/10 at `low` for the same model. More thinking did not help this model, and it cost almost 9 times as much as `minimal` (`$12.05` vs. `$1.39`) and took 117 minutes instead of 12.
- At `high` the model reasons at length: about 4,500 reasoning tokens per call (none at `minimal` or `low`). Agents used 51 steps on average, 2 of 10 reached the step limit, and context was summarized 6.5 times per agent (0.5 at `minimal`).
- Compared with `gemini-3.8-flash` at `high` under the same budgets (1/10 and 0/10), this model still finished far more often: 7 of 10 agents pushed work, against 0 to 1 of 10.
- No API rate-limit retries.
